name: hcportal_getPermissionMatrix
description: Loads the data-driven permission matrix (Permissions V2) for the super-admin editor: the function catalog, the grantor catalog (mismanagement roles + app-access flags; the SuperAdmin bypass grantor is excluded), the current GLOBAL grants, and — when @publicKennelId is given — that kennel's override rows. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth; service accounts (callerType != 0) refused; the caller must hold an active HC.PlatformAdmin row with CanManagePermissions = 1.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID used to resolve the hasher and validate the token.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived portal token validated via ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: When set, rowset 4 returns that kennel's override rows (else empty).

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always first. Success=0 (and nothing else) on auth failure, service-account caller, or missing CanManagePermissions privilege. Success=1 with ErrorMessage NULL precedes rowsets 1-4. A runtime error after the envelope is logged to HC.ErrorLog and re-thrown (THROW), so the client sees Success=1 followed by an exception.

rowsets.name: Functions
rowsets.description: Function catalog (matrix columns) ordered by SortOrder. Still includes the legacy enterRunAdmin/enterKennelAdmin gate rows; the derived-entry editor filters them out.

columns.name: AreaKey
columns.description: Stable area slug the editor groups by and derives entry from. Added by db/hc6/app/archive/migration_permissions_v4_01_surfaces_areakey.sql.

columns.name: Surfaces
columns.description: Bitmask of the surfaces (app / portal) the function applies to. Added by migration_permissions_v4_01_surfaces_areakey.sql.

columns.name: HareScoped
columns.description: 1 if a run's hare also gets it

rowsets.name: Grantors
rowsets.description: Grantor catalog (matrix rows), GrantorType <> 'bypass', ordered by GrantorType, SortOrder.

rowsets.name: GlobalGrants
rowsets.description: Current global grants (KennelId NULL, granted). Present only when Success=1.

rowsets.name: KennelOverrides
rowsets.description: Override rows for the kennel resolved from @publicKennelId. Empty when @publicKennelId is NULL or does not match a kennel (no error is raised for an unknown kennel).

columns.name: Allowed
columns.description: Tri-state override: 1 = grant, -1 = revoke, 0 = inherit the global default

sideEffects: On a runtime error: INSERT HC.ErrorLog, then THROW

codeSmells.issue: Success envelope sent before the data queries
codeSmells.detail: Line 57 selects Success=1 first; a failure in lines 63-81 is then thrown after the client has already read Success=1.
Lines 52-54: a @publicKennelId that matches no kennel leaves @kennelScopeId NULL and rowset 4 empty, indistinguishable from a kennel with no overrides.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change the rowset order (0=envelope, 1=functions, 2=grantors, 3=global grants, 4=kennel overrides)
